concerns.text: Constitution VII mandates all listed confounds (age, time of day, baseline complexity, medication status) MUST be included as covariates or controlled for. T021 allows ANCOVA to be skipped entirely ('If the valid-predictor list is empty... Skipping ANCOVA') and T018's primary delta-delta correlation includes no covariates at all. The confound-control requirement is silently droppable; either guarantee confound control in the primary analysis or document/justify the deviation as the constitution requires.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T020 vs contracts/analysis_output.schema.yaml vs constitution.md:Principle VII
concerns.text: Constitution VII requires effect sizes and 95% CIs to be reported. T018 computes CIs into raw_correlation_results.csv, but the FINAL artifact correlation_results.csv (T020) conforms to analysis_output.schema.yaml, which has no CI fields — CIs are silently dropped from the final output. Add CI columns to the contract/task or carry the CI-bearing artifact forward.

T009 names PhysioNet eegmat as primary candidate, but FR-001 requires paired pre/post fatigue ratings from a sustained-attention task on a validated instrument; eegmat's ratings may not satisfy this, and no alternate candidate is recorded. If validation fails the pipeline dead-ends. Record an alternate candidate dataset in the task/plan so FR-001's 'identify a public dataset' is not a single point of failure.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T023 vs contracts/sensitivity_table.schema.yaml vs plan.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: T023 produces sensitivity_table_raw.csv and sensitivity_table_corrected.csv with columns (threshold, significant_electrodes_count), but the contract and plan specify a single sensitivity_table.csv. FR-006 requires 'a table in the final analysis report'; reconcile file names and the schema so the deliverable matches the contract.

Plan task T005 says 'Verify VIF < 5' (SC-004), while T024 says 'Do NOT abort if VIF ≥ 5; log a warning only.' The relaxation may be reasonable, but it is an undocumented deviation from the plan's verification language — state explicitly in the task that SC-004 is diagnostic-only, not a gate, so the weakening is intentional and traceable.
